policy: Positive nameable smells: train macro-domain Youden, FPR <=1% overall and <=2.5% each domain, search recall >=0.05%. Require >=20 train / >=5 dev AI hits, support >=2 domains with >=2 hits, and >=3x overall human rate. No model-count requirement. Specificity absence alone is research-only. No external fitting.
